name: Star Troopers - Combat Force
description:
Enter a high-speed combat arena where every second matters and every move decides your survival.

Set in a futuristic cyberpunk world, you fight as an elite operator inside advanced simulation arenas controlled by powerful corporations. Move constantly and use speed and positioning to stay in control during intense combat encounters.

Dash, jump, and react instantly while collecting resources and adapting to fast-changing combat situations. Each arena offers vertical gameplay, interactive elements, and multiple ways to approach every fight.

Key Features:
	•	Arena Shooter Gameplay: Fast-paced combat in dynamic arenas
	•	Cyberpunk Setting: Neon environments and futuristic locations
	•	Dynamic Movement: Dash, double jump, and vertical gameplay
	•	Interactive Arenas: Power-ups, destructible elements, and multi-level design
	•	Challenging Encounters: Test your reflexes and reaction speed
Fight, adapt, and stay one step ahead in a world built for combat.

Star Troopers – Combat Force delivers an intense, fast-paced shooter experience where reflexes, movement, and precision define every battle.
